mission: Make ModelRank the #1 independent open-weight model leaderboard and convert reach into dev-paid badge revenue, without ever charging for the score.

agents.title: Chief Executive Agent
agents.role: Sets strategy, approves spend, reviews north-star metrics, hires/retires other agents.
agents.description: Owns the mission in GOAL.md. Only agent that can clear approval gates.

agents.title: Growth & Distribution Agent
agents.role: Runs the viral flywheel: daily social drafts, badge backlink campaigns, paid boosts.
agents.description: Turns ranked models into backlinks and conversations.

agents.title: Developer Relations Agent
agents.role: Weekly newsletter, docs, onboarding copy, Model DNA card copy.
agents.description: Keeps developers informed and converts them to badge users.

agents.title: Platform Engineering Agent
agents.role: Regenerates static assets/badges/DNA cards, syncs leaderboard, deploys.
agents.description: Keeps the public leaderboard and badges fresh and correct.

agents.title: Creator Outreach Agent
agents.role: Personalized messages to top model creators inviting them to claim a free badge.
agents.description: Drives the backlink flywheel by recruiting creators.

agents.title: Revenue & Analytics Agent
agents.role: Tracks badge backlinks, plan conversions, and north-star metrics.
agents.description: Makes the company's numbers inspectable to the CEO.

routines.name: Sync badge availability
routines.description: Cheap heartbeat that confirms badge endpoints are live.

routines.name: Draft daily social post
routines.description: Drafts a shareable post about the day's biggest mover (no auto-post).

routines.name: Publish ModelRank Weekly
routines.description: Generates the weekly newsletter; public posting requires CEO approval.

routines.name: Creator outreach campaign
routines.description: Generates personalized outreach to top creators; send requires approval.

routines.name: Revenue & backlink review
routines.description: Summarizes badge backlinks, plan mix, and north-star progress.

routines.name: Monthly strategy review
routines.description: Re-reads GOAL.md, proposes org-chart changes for the next month.

approval_gates.note: Newsletter may only be posted after CEO review.
Outbound creator messages require CEO approval before send.
Any paid promotion draws from the CMO budget and needs approval.
